dct_description_sm: A dataset that contains elevation contours in polyline ZM format for the Township of Uxbridge. This information has been produced by First Base Solutions Inc. The DESC_ field indicates whether a contour is a major (CONTOUR_INDEX) or minor (CONTOUR_INTER). The Elevation field indicates the contour's value in metres(m) above the sea level reference datum.
schema_provider_s: City of Pickering Open Data Portal
